newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ciadea cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ciadea cut to sell.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Thursday it had downgraded its rating for Argentine automaker Ciadea SA to sell from hold.
-- Analyst Martin Pradier wrote in a report that Ciadea's sales have risen 1.5 percent on a year-on-year basis, while industry car sales in Argentina have risen 10.5 pct.
-- "The trend to lower margins is set to continue as new companies are installing plants in Argentina," he wrote, adding that on valuation basis the company's shares looked expensive.
-- Pradier revised downward his estimates for fiscal year 1996 for earnings per share (EPS) to 0.11 peso from 0.27 and EPS for fiscal year to 0.18 peso from 0.66 peso.
-- Ciadea is the local licensee of France's Renault SA.
